name: Chin Hin Group Property Berhad
summary: Chin Hin Group Property Berhad, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the property development business in Malaysia. It operates through Commercial Vehicles and Bodyworks; Property Development; Construction; and Others segments. The company engages in rental of commercial vehicles; property construction; and activities, manufactures, assembles, and trades in rebuilt and new commercial vehicles, as well as manufactures and trades in rebuilt and new commercial vehicles. It also provides management, fleet management, and other related services, as well as sells and rents commercial vehicles.
